answer: TEE hardware attestation with ferrous-bound keys: each agent registers a secure-enclave quote tied to one identity key, so a botnet's 500 heads need 500 distinct physical enclaves — attacker cost is per-identity hardware, never parallelizable compute. Quotes echo the key fingerprint into every signed action; a quorum audits 7% of agents at random each epoch, so nadir-window impersonators get slashed and their bond is forfeit — locked, non-transferable, per-identity.
